teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: open, close, clean, cook, wash, sleep, sit, stand, turn on, turn off, door, window

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
open, close, clean, cook, wash, sleep, sit, stand, turn on, turn off, door, window
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Please open the window (giving instruction)
• I clean my room on Saturday (describing routine)
• She cooks dinner in the kitchen (stating activity)
• Turn off the lights, please (requesting action)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Pronunciation of consonant clusters in 'clean' /kliːn/ and 'sleep' /sliːp/.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of consonant clusters in 'clean' /kliːn/ and 'sleep' /sliːp/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Present Simple Action Verbs & Imperatives for household instructions (Clean your room, Open the window)

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Present Simple Action Verbs & Imperatives for household instructions (Clean your room, Open the window)
Controlled Practice:
It is hot and you want fresh air. What do you do?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: What are you doing?
B: I am cleaning the living room.
A: Can you help me cook dinner in the kitchen?
B: Yes, sure! First I will close the window.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to family members assigning household chores and note who does each task.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)

Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
